scope: Read-only CPU audit of already saved official VAL arrays; no GPU, no new sampling/training, no checkpoint selection change.
confirmed_findings: All 394 eligible RICH TRAIN windows have been covered repeatedly; natural sampling share alone does not establish absent coverage.
RICH noisy observed-joint error improves while hidden-joint error can regress severely.
Fixed panel Pavallion_006_yoga1 noisy is a major outlier but other fixed cases also regress.
This case has 192/192 missing right ankle and right foot position observations, with visible right knee position.
Local right-knee rotation has no evidence; reference initializes identity with .05 rotation confidence.
IK ancestry strength for right-knee rotation is exactly zero, so observation IK cannot directly change that local rotation.
Source-derived GT right-knee local angle median is8.2deg, max30.3deg; 8k noisy prediction median156deg, clean7.9deg.
Saved reference CPU recomputation matches within5.1e-6 feature units. Root SVD second singular value stays above.00179, no degenerate fit observed.
Clean/noisy use the same DDIM seed. Extra noisy gap is right elbow frames18..35; right-leg masks unchanged.
limits: No proof yet that global scene/feedback versus denoiser itself causes the knee flip; saved arrays do not retain internal DDIM intermediates.
No cause is established by sample-count statistics alone.
No full raw-data alignment proof; this audit checks the saved RICH validation paths and reference construction for the identified failure.
